title: Provenance files for every task directory
description: The Bias in Bios tasks, the stereotype tasks, the loan-narrative tasks, the opinion-claims task and both Gaza tasks have no README or LICENSE in their directory, and the data manifest points at a path on a private machine. Give every task directory a README (source, licence, how the items were selected, what was redacted) and a LICENSE, and replace the private path in the manifest with the public source. Remove the stray build summary at the top of tasks/ that carries local paths.
